patterns.note: The homepage uses a full-width, stacked section layout, with some sections featuring a grid for showcasing font examples or articles, and others using large, centered display text.
Typography is a central design element, with large, bold display typefaces used for key statements and product showcases, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
The site employs a high-contrast palette of dark text on light backgrounds, punctuated by vibrant, distinct accent colors used in full-width blocks to highlight individual font products.

A large, abstract graphic hero element scrolls out of view, revealing the main content. The primary navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after scrolling, and its logo subtly changes color from black to red upon activation.
Product showcases utilize large, colorful, full-width blocks, each dedicated to a single typeface, making the font names themselves a prominent visual feature.

technique_notes: The site's motion system uses a sticky header that transforms (logo color change) after a scroll threshold, while a large initial hero graphic scrolls naturally with the page content. Content sections are revealed by standard scrolling, without complex fade-in or slide animations, relying on the page's natural flow. The vibrant, full-width color blocks for font showcases are implemented as distinct background sections with centered text, leveraging strong color contrast to differentiate each product.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than body text, with hero and section titles reaching display sizes (~4-5x body) to emphasize key messages and font names.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — with airy sections for hero and key statements, and a more compact grid for product listings and articles.

standout: This site stands out by making its product—typefaces—the core of its visual design. The bold, full-width color blocks for each font, combined with the site's own strong display typography, effectively showcase the product's character. The initial abstract graphic hero also provides a distinctive, artistic opening.
